correctness.rationale: Verified (a)-(d) from admitted Corollary 15 input. (a) E>=c q^{-2N} with Weyl deg-4 growth gives zeta_1 convergence for Re(s)>0; |Tr(P b P)|<=||pi(b)|| dim gives |zeta_b|<=||b|| zeta_1(Re s) and holomorphy by uniform convergence on half-planes. (b) q-number identity factored per branch yields E=K q^{-2N}B with B(0,0)=1, c0 displayed and others checked analogously; numerics match to 1e-9. (c) Uniform B^{-s/2}=1+O(s) plus Eulerian n^a e^{-s'n}~a!/s'^{a+1} gives 80 per signed family, 8 families = 640, lower terms O(s^{-5}); independently recomputed 32+32+16=80. (d) 1D Taylor-with-remainder lemma gives Eulerian rationality in q^{s+j} with exact order d+1=4 on L_q, j>=1 holomorphic near lattice points; degree-3 applies to each fixed row/column. Limitations honestly scoped; numerics are illustration only.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING genuinely arose from the admitted target investigation on the same B2 triple and zeta functions, so absence from topic.json is not adverse. Source paper (Diaz Garcia-O Buachalla-Wagner) stops at eigenvalues, multiplicities, and 0+-summability: full-text search of its 146602-char extraction finds no 'dimension spectrum', 'zeta', or 'meromorphic'. Quantum-projective-space predecessor likewise contains none and concerns a different object. Fused 20-result search returned only construction/spectrum papers and no zeta-continuation, pole-lattice, pole-order, or Tauberian computation for the B2 triple. Parts (a)-(d) are therefore new and not implied by prior work.

value.rationale: First zeta-function structural theorem for the motivated B2-irreducible Dolbeault-Dirac triple: rules out the entire right half-plane for the future dimension spectrum for every b, quantifies the b=1 singularity with exact constant 640/(log q^{-1})^6, exhibits the exact factorised q-series input any complete Sd computation must use, and proves full sector continuation with exact orders as a reusable model transferable to other irreducible quantum flag manifolds. This is a proved structural theorem with an exact invariant of a natural object, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; judged on its self-contained headline, the open bulk-2D continuation does not erase its standalone retrieval value.
